claim_one_line: THE ORBIT THAT REMEMBERS 2T. B1256 registered I-25 UNEARNED -- the objects SL(2) was assumed to embed in E6 via the PRINCIPAL sl2, a choice never derived, which decides the typing of h^1 and hence the generation count. THE ARCHAEOLOGY: the assumption entered at B327 (the principal 27 decomposition is V(16)+V(8)+V(0); fence: Exact E6 Weyl-orbit + principal grading) and was never revisited across ~930 arcs -- while B327s OWN bibliography line reads Kostant (principal SL(2)); the McKay correspondence 2T <-> E6-tilde (Gonzalez-Sprinberg-Verdier, SLODOWY). Both cited, only Kostants used; the theorem that selects the other orbit sat one clause away, unused. THE CRITERION: Brieskorn-Slodowy says the Slodowy slice to a nilpotent orbit meets the nilpotent cone in dimension dim N - dim O, and for the SUBREGULAR orbit this is a simple surface singularity C^2/Gamma of the same ADE type -- for E6, Gamma = 2T. Since the objects E6 was BUILT from 2T by McKay (I-1, EARNED), ask which orbits geometry RETURNS the group the algebra was built from. EXACTLY ONE OF THIRTY DOES: the subregular, dim O = 70, dim(S cap N) = 2 = a SURFACE = C^2/2T, while the principal orbit gives dim 0, a POINT, forgetting 2T entirely; the other 28 give neither. Its 27-decomposition, READ OFF AFTER THE SELECTION AND NEVER USED TO MAKE IT, is 13+9+5 -- three nontrivial odd summands, no trivial one, hence h^1 = 3 ALL CHIRAL by B1256s computed addendum. A canonical, unique, non-fitted criterion selecting exactly the embedding that gives three chiral generations, replacing a default with NO attachment to the objects own 2T. DOES NOT claim the holonomy realises it: both orbits are intrinsic to E6, and what distinguishes the subregular is a CLOSURE condition, not a preference. Needs only I-1 (EARNED) plus the internal coherence of the ADE correspondence -- NOT I-6, which is a different geometric claim. I-25 stays UNEARNED; this is a named candidate route. FENCE: the dimensions, the uniqueness of the dim-70 row, the decompositions and the three-chiral typing are all VERIFIED on bench; the Brieskorn-Slodowy theorem itself (subregular slice = the ADE surface singularity, E6 <-> 2T) is CITED, NOT VERIFIED here, and nothing downstream may treat that step as bench-verified until it is.
